A '''mag-pulse device''' was a piece of equipment that was commonly used to erase [[Computer/Legends|computer]] records in a hurry. In the event of the evacuation of a military installation, computers needed to be wiped to prevent the contents from falling into enemy. Mag-pulse devices were employed to ensure vital intelligence was not recovered, but it was considered to be wasteful bridge-burning.<ref name="EGTD" />
